today.desc_follicular: Energy is rising. Your skin is clearer, your mind sharper. A great time to plan and create.
today.desc_ovulation: You are at your peak. Confidence is high, skin is luminous, and connection comes naturally.
today.desc_luteal: Slowing down is wisdom. Your body is preparing. Honour what you need and be gentle with yourself.
today.desc_unknown: Log your first period to unlock your personal cycle insights.
today.cta_follicular: This week your skin is at its clearest. A great time to book a wax or a facial.
today.cta_ovulation: Your skin is luminous right now. Make the most of it with a treatment.

log.title: tara-s
log.body: She has always known her body. This space is yours to remember.

insights.title: What your body is telling you.
insights.subtitle: Patterns drawn from what you have logged.
insights.empty_title: Your patterns will surface here as you log.
insights.need_more_data_title: Keep logging. Your patterns are forming.
insights.need_more_data_body: Log one more cycle and TARA-S will begin to see your rhythm.
insights.avg_duration: Your period usually lasts about {days} days.
insights.variability_consistent: Your cycles have been very consistent lately.
insights.variability_regular: Your cycles are fairly regular. Small variations are completely normal.
insights.variability_irregular: Your last few cycles have varied by about {days} days. Stress, travel, or illness can cause this.

information.disclaimer_body: TARA-S is built on thorough research, and we hold that research to a high standard. But every woman's body is beautifully unique. Our aim is simply to offer the best possible experience and to walk alongside you through the natural phases of your cycle.

privacy.title: What we hold, and why.
privacy.subtitle: This is yours. All of it.
privacy.section_collect_body: Your dates. Your symptoms. Nothing else. We do not need your location, your contacts, or your habits outside this app.
privacy.section_storage_body: Held securely. Never shared, never sold, never handed to anyone, for any reason.
privacy.section_control_body: Take it all with you, or let it go completely. One tap to download everything. One tap to delete it all, forever.
privacy.export_error: Something went wrong. Please try again.
privacy.delete_confirm: This will permanently delete everything. It cannot be undone. Are you sure?
privacy.delete_modal_body: Once this is done, it cannot be undone. Every date, every symptom, everything you have shared here will be gone. Are you sure you want to let it all go?

onboarding.welcome_body: Before we begin, a few questions to find your rhythm.
onboarding.name_sub: TARA-S will use this to greet you.
onboarding.date_q1: When did your last period begin?
onboarding.date_q1_sub: This helps us find where you are in your cycle today.
onboarding.date_q2_sub: Two dates help us find your rhythm.
onboarding.date_q3_sub: Three dates and we can begin to see your pattern.
onboarding.ready_sub: TARA-S will learn alongside you. The more you log, the more she understands.
